worktree_setup.commands[].index: ignored: the commands are listed in the order they ran, so the number adds nothing
worktree_setup.commands[].cwd: ignored: every setup command runs inside the new copy, whose folder is already shown
worktree_setup.commands[].durationMs: ignored: how long a setup step took is not needed to read the result
shell.cwd: ignored: commands run in the project folder, and the command line says what ran
search.webResults[].title: shown
search.durationMs: ignored: how long a search took is not needed to read the result
search.durationSeconds: ignored: how long a search took is not needed to read the result
search.mode: ignored: a search setting; the list of results already shows what it returned
fetch.bytes: ignored: the size of the page is not needed to read what it said
fetch.durationMs: ignored: how long a download took is not needed to read the result
sub_agent.childSessionId: ignored: an internal id; the sub-agent is named by its type and task
sub_agent.actions[].index: ignored: the actions are listed in the order they ran, so the number adds nothing
plain_text.label: shown
plain_text.icon: ignored: which glyph the agent picked; the app draws its own icon per kind of step
